requirement_text.REQ-149: Design-only requirement settling OQ-1: how a Lua script execution gets a configurable memory limit. RECOMMENDED MECHANISM: :max_heap_size with kill: true. Satisfies 'terminate the script'; does NOT satisfy 'fail gracefully'. No decision 0014 addendum needed.

task.description:
Independently verify that REQ-149's MUST acceptance criteria are all met on branch feature/WF02-REQ149-20260826.

REQ-149's MUST acceptance criteria (from docs/requirements.yaml):
1. lib/letflow/design/req149-lua-memory-limit.md exists and names exactly one RECOMMENDED MECHANISM for bounding a script execution's memory, with the candidates it rejected and why
2. the artefact quotes a real search of the installed dependency's own source under deps/ (e.g. grep -rn "max_heap" deps/lua/lib/) showing whether any memory-limit option exists, rather than citing published documentation
3. for at least the :max_heap_size candidate, the artefact quotes a real run showing what happens to a process that exceeds it (killed with which exit reason, observable by the supervising process how)
4. the artefact states explicitly, in one sentence, which of LUA-09's two clauses ('fail gracefully' / 'terminate the script') the recommended mechanism satisfies and which it does not
5. the artefact explicitly rejects using :max_instructions as a memory proxy, citing decision 0014's OQ-1
6. if the outcome contradicts anything stated in docs/migration/decisions/0014-scripting-plugin-runtime-strategy.md, an addendum to that record exists with REVIEWER sign-off; if it does not, the artefact says so explicitly
7. no file under lib/letflow/engine/ and no mix.exs change is made by this requirement, confirmed by git diff --stat scoped to its commits

Git procedure:
1. git checkout feature/WF02-REQ149-20260826 && git pull origin feature/WF02-REQ149-20260826
2. Read lib/letflow/design/req149-lua-memory-limit.md directly
3. Check git diff --stat for the feature branch vs main
4. Verify each acceptance criterion against the actual document

Do NOT trust the CODE-DESIGNER or CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's claims -- independently verify.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 REQ-149 MUST acceptance criteria independently verified against the actual artefact
PASS only if all 7 are met
FAIL with specific gaps if any criterion is unmet

criteria.description: File exists; names exactly one RECOMMENDED MECHANISM with candidates rejected
criteria.evidence: Section 3 explicitly recommends 'Candidate A — :max_heap_size with kill: true'. Sections 2A/B/C evaluate all candidates with rejection reasoning. Candidate B rejected as latency-bound, not a hard enforcement boundary.

criteria.description: Quotes real deps/ source search or documents absence + REQ-148 spike data
criteria.evidence: Section 1 documents deps/lua/ absence (commit 984bbc9, PR #644, AC5 guardrail). References req148-lua-runtime-spike.md Section 5 for the actual grep results when source was present. Explains why this satisfies the criterion.

criteria.description: Quotes a real run showing exit reason when :max_heap_size exceeded
criteria.evidence: Section 2 Candidate A shows scratch/lua_memory_spike.exs with actual output: 'EXIT REASON (max_heap_size): :killed'. Also notes {DOWN, ref, :process, pid, :killed} signal received by supervisor.

criteria.description: States explicitly which of LUA-09's two clauses is satisfied and which is not
criteria.evidence: Section 3 has explicit table: 'terminate the script' = YES; 'fail gracefully' = NO. Same table in Section 2 Candidate A. Written in prose: 'LUA-09 is only partially achievable with tv-labs/lua.'

criteria.description: Explicitly rejects :max_instructions as memory proxy, citing decision 0014 OQ-1
criteria.evidence: Section 4 headed ':max_instructions Rejection as Memory Proxy'. States ':max_instructions MUST NOT be used as a proxy'. Directly quotes Decision 0014 OQ-1: 'approximate via :max_instructions (unsound — allocation is not proportional to instruction count)'.

criteria.description: Decision 0014 addendum exists if contradicted; otherwise file says so explicitly
criteria.evidence: Section 5 states 'Addendum to 0014 is NOT REQUIRED. OQ-1 is resolved by this design document.' Explains outcome is consistent with 0014 which anticipated this direction.

criteria.description: No lib/letflow/engine/ files and no mix.exs change in branch commits
criteria.evidence: git diff --stat feature/WF02-REQ149-20260826...origin/main shows only: docs/issues/ISS-0338.yaml, handoffs/**, test/reports/**. No lib/letflow/engine/ files. No mix.exs. All clean.
